text.t:
Our personalised initials are made from pine plywood, where the natural beauty of wood meets the delicacy of a name in gold or white acrylic, carefully placed in the centre of the letter.
Each initial receives a final touch with a meticulously chosen ribbon: tartan, gold, or red velvet, for an elegant, cosy, and charming result.
A unique piece, designed to personalise your Christmas tree, decorate a gift, or add a special detail to your home decor.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: It is an ornament and not a toy: hang it out of reach of small children, who may put it in their mouths.
